_meta.purpose: DB-index -> engine target bridge for the JUNO-60 capture-free preset path.
_meta.path_used: B (semantic + ordered alignment + cross-preset validation). Path A (static table) was conclusively ruled out: the DB->engine setter (CPrmDSPSystem8Dly<CPrmDSPJu60> vtable+88, rva 0x3B1790) is a retn-0 nullsub; the only runtime bridge is sub_7FF91E027AE0's red-black tree keyed by VST3 ParamID with DB-index in node+8, passed verbatim (no db->offset arithmetic) to that nullsub. So there is NO static numeric DB-index->offset map; semantic alignment is required.
_meta.engine_paramId: base-voice paramID (0..109) per docs/PARAM_MAP.tsv; render broadcasts to all 8 voices (paramID + 110*v / offset + 10512*v). For FX/global/driver selectors engine_paramId is null and 'driver_target' names the destination.
_meta.value_domain: A DB step (0..255) IS the engine LUT step, except where 'value_bias' is given (the engine's own bridge applies it): subtract value_bias before LUT lookup.
_meta.block2_correction: IMPORTANT: refs/preset_bank.json's db_global_fx_params (DB854..877) used a WRONG +200 offset (DB864/DB868 violated their ranges). The CORRECT decode is stride-4 from the reverb anchor: pos = 321 + (db-876)*4, which yields 24/24 range-fit and matches every selector default. Values in sqarpg_engine_steps.json use the corrected decode.
_meta.honest_boundary: Continuous block-1 synth params (DCO pulse/saw/sub levels, PWM depth, VCF cutoff/res/env-amount, ENV A/D/S/R, LFO rate/depth) are decoded to DB index (proven) but their bijective DB-index->engine-paramID pairing inside the System-8 multi-OSC layout is NOT statically provable and was NOT guessed. They are listed in db_engine_unmapped.

760.name: OSC1 Feet
760.note: DB spec '64..2 FEET' == engine 'OSC1 Feet'; the one statically-proven pair.

870.name: Master Tune
870.note: DB870 -1200..+1200CENT def=128 center == engine pid3 'Master Tune'. All 64 presets read 128 (untouched) -> consistent.

873.name: JUNO Chorus mode (driver chorus_mode)
873.note: DB873 = OVERDRIVE|DISTORTION|JUNO CH1|JUNO CH2|CRUSHER|PHASER. JUNO CH1(33)/JUNO CH2(22) are the authentic JUNO-60 chorus I/II; PHASER(8),DISTORTION(1) are alt character fx. This is the JUNO chorus selector. Maps to master_render chorus_mode (host-params +136/+112). mode 0 = bypass.

875.name: System-8 FX-A type (delay/mod slot)
875.note: DB875 = DELAY|PAN DELAY|CHORUS 1|CHORUS 2|FLANGER|DELAY+CHORUS. Separate System-8 modulation/delay slot (the delay/chorus instances at engine offsets 6396xxx/10693xxx). 29 DELAY, 17 PAN DELAY, 10 CHORUS1...

876.name: Reverb type
876.method: discrete-spec-unique + reverb anchor (HALL2 for SQ ARPG validated)

872.name: Filter type (LPF/HPF slope)
872.note: DB872 = LPF-24/-18/-12 | HPF-12/-18/-24. All factory presets that are pure JUNO use LPF-24 (0). engine LPF is -24dB/oct (4-pole).

871.name: Model JUNO-60/106
871.note: DB871 = JUNO-60(0)|JUNO-106(1). Bridge switch case 871 sets value=(a3!=0). All 64 bank presets = 0 (JUNO-60).

868.name: Sub-osc waveform
868.note: DB868 = -2OCT SIN|-1OCT SIN|SIN|TRI|-1OCT TRI|-2OCT TRI. The corrected stride-4 decode gives 0..5 (range-valid); the old +200 decode gave 0..255 (invalid).

800.name: Key Assign (POLY1/MONO/UNISON/POLY2)
800.note: DB800 = POLY1|MONO|UNISON|POLY2. Validated: BS(bass) presets 9/11 = MONO(1); all 12 PD(pad) = POLY1(0). Voice-allocation mode (not a per-voice LUT slot).

759.name: PWM source -> PWM SW {LFO/ENV1/ENV2/Manual}
759.note: DB759 = MAN|LFO|ENV1+|ENV1-|ENV2+|ENV2-. Engine has 4 PWM switches pid46 PWM SW LFO(3888), pid47 ENV1(3904), pid48 ENV2(3920), pid49 Manual(3936). Mapping: 0->Manual on; 1->LFO on; 2,3->ENV1 on; 4,5->ENV2 on (sign = ENV polarity, carried separately). SQ ARPG=0 -> Manual PWM.

769.name: Coarse transpose/range (+-11)
769.note: Bridge switch explicitly biases DB769 by -11 (bipolar). Spec -11..+11. All 64 presets store 11 (=> 0 after bias) -> a fixed/centered coarse pitch. SQ ARPG=11 -> 0 semitone offset.

770.name: JU OSC Sqr Lev (tentative)
770.method: section-semantic (DCO mixer) + cross-preset; saw/sqr assignment not bijective
770.note: DB770 a DCO mixer level (def128, all presets present). Tentatively the pulse/square level. SQ ARPG=255 (full).

771.name: JU OSC Saw Lev (tentative)
771.method: section-semantic (DCO mixer); saw/sqr assignment not bijective
771.note: DB771 a DCO mixer level (def0). Tentatively the saw level. SQ ARPG=255 (full).

772.name: JU OSC Sub Lev (tentative)
772.method: section-semantic + cross-preset (BS mean 172 >> PD 30: bass-heavy = SUB)
772.note: DB772 (BS=172, PD=30) tracks bass-heavy patches strongly -> tentatively SUB level. SQ ARPG=159.

779.name: Osc Noise Level (tentative)
779.method: section-semantic (noise) + the PINK/WHITE selector (DB775) is adjacent
779.note: DB779 (all-present 15..251, def255) is the noise-section level next to the PINK/WHITE selector DB775. SQ ARPG=90.

795.name: ENV Sustain (VCA, tentative)
795.method: cross-preset (PD 136 >> BS 52: pads sustain) + spec OFF|1..255
795.note: DB795 (OFF|1..255) tracks pad>bass -> tentatively the VCA/amp envelope SUSTAIN. SQ ARPG=195. ENV1 vs ENV2 assignment not proven.

796.name: ENV Release (VCA, tentative)
796.method: cross-preset (PD 93 >> BS 20: pads release long) + spec OFF|1..255
796.note: DB796 (OFF|1..255) tracks pad>bass -> tentatively the VCA/amp envelope RELEASE. SQ ARPG=96. ENV1 vs ENV2 assignment not proven.

db_engine_unmapped.note: Decoded to DB index (proven) but NOT bijectively mappable to an engine paramID without the runtime tree. Left out per the no-fabrication rule.

continuous_block1.766: centered param (def128, all 64 = 128) - untouched in every preset.
continuous_block1.781,782,784,785,786,787: VCF/ENV modulation amounts & levels (centered or level). DB784/786 track pad>>bass (movement/LFO/VCF-env) but exact target unproven.
continuous_block1.783,788,793,797,810: centered/always-present params (cutoff, env amount, VCA level candidates) - section plausible, exact engine offset unproven.
continuous_block1.789,790,791,792,794: levels/gates (DB794 near-binary on; DB791 usually full).

discrete_block1.756: OFF|ON (bridge case 756 has an extra side-effect setter) - SQ ARPG=1.

global_block2.854,855,856,857,862,863,864,866,867,869,: global ENV/mod/level fields (corrected stride-4 decode). DB858-861 are global ENV-time-like (def 43/43/22/22) but show only coarse quantized values across the bank, not clean ADSR; not the primary audible envelope. DB874 = drive/character amount for DB873.

sqarpg_chorus_and_lfo.fxA_db875: DELAY (value 0) - no extra chorus in the System-8 FX-A slot.
sqarpg_chorus_and_lfo.answer_vibrato: The audible chorus/vibrato is a PRESET param: DB873 selects JUNO Chorus I, which drives master_render's chorus_mode (a real BBD-chorus stage), NOT a transcription artifact. Plus the patch's own LFO->pitch (block-1) adds vibrato. SQ ARPG should render WITH JUNO Chorus I engaged.
